tasks.title: Initialize the TypeScript workspace
tasks.details: Create the Node.js 24 LTS, ESM, strict TypeScript workspace with package boundaries, linting, formatting, test tooling, and repository hygiene from the specification.
steps: Create package manifests and TypeScript configuration.
Add lint, format, test, and build scripts.

tasks.title: Define shared schemas and data contracts
tasks.details: Implement versioned schemas and TypeScript types for ContractIR, PackIR, RunProfile, StudyProtocol, PhasePlan, traces, artifacts, diagnostics, and reports.
steps: Create schema packages for shared data contracts.
Generate or validate TypeScript types from schemas.

tasks.title: Implement source resolution and CLI shell
tasks.details: Build the oal command shell, source resolution rules, stable output rules, and stable exit codes.
steps: Implement JSON and terminal output modes.
Add source resolution for documents, packs, runs, and studies.
Map failures to stable exit codes.

tasks.title: Build OpenAPI input parsing
tasks.details: Accept bounded OpenAPI 3.0.x and 3.1.x JSON or YAML inputs with deterministic parsing limits and clear diagnostics.
steps: Parse JSON and YAML input files.
Apply size, depth, and resource limits.

tasks.title: Resolve same-pack local references
tasks.details: Resolve local OpenAPI references safely and deterministically while rejecting remote references and unsafe paths.
steps: Implement document graph loading for same-pack files.
Detect cycles and excessive reference depth.
Emit stable diagnostics for unsupported references.

tasks.title: Compile canonical operations
tasks.details: Compile every parsed HTTP operation into ContractIR with stable operation identity, route metadata, request metadata, and response metadata.
steps: Compile path and method route records.
Compile parameters, request bodies, responses, and security.
Preserve unsupported operations in the capability report.

tasks.title: Implement capability reporting
tasks.details: Produce machine-readable per-document and per-operation support outcomes with stable diagnostics and support matrix coverage.
steps: Define supported, approximated, requires-scenario, and unsupported outcomes.
Attach stable reason codes to each outcome.
Report feature coverage at document and operation levels.

tasks.title: Validate OpenAPI request data
tasks.details: Validate path, query, header, cookie, and body inputs against compiled operation metadata.
steps: Validate required fields and schema constraints.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic response generation
tasks.details: Generate schema-valid contract responses from examples, defaults, enums, schemas, and seeded deterministic fallback values.
steps: Select examples and example values deterministically.
Validate generated responses before returning them.

tasks.title: Build the HTTP gateway
tasks.details: Start a loopback mock server that routes supported operations, handles framework defaults, enforces validation, and records accepted and rejected requests.
steps: Map ContractIR routes to the server.

tasks.title: Implement authentication emulation
tasks.details: Emulate supported OpenAPI security requirements with synthetic per-run credentials and deterministic authorization failures.
steps: Generate synthetic credentials for a trial.
Redact credential material in traces and reports.

tasks.title: Implement content negotiation and HTTP semantics
tasks.details: Support request and response media negotiation, headers, status rules, wire semantics, and explicit framework defaults.
steps: Add tests for HTTP edge cases.

tasks.title: Create the SQLite state store
tasks.details: Implement the transactional SQLite source of truth for runs, trials, mutable state, requests, events, artifacts, idempotency, and terminal disposition.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic seed and clock services
tasks.details: Provide deterministic seed derivation, virtual time, request ordering, and concurrency behavior for repeatable runs.
steps: Persist request order and state revision data.

tasks.title: Define pack manifests and invariants
tasks.details: Implement pack manifest parsing, PackIR creation, validation, invariants, task definitions, prompt sets, fixtures, scenarios, and result schemas.

tasks.title: Implement pack authoring commands
tasks.details: Add oal pack init and oal pack validate for scenario pack authors.
steps: Validate referenced OpenAPI documents and eval files.

tasks.title: Implement behavior backend API
tasks.details: Create the behavior backend interface, request envelope, response contract, state mutation semantics, and behavior error handling.
steps: Define TypeScript interfaces for behavior backends.
Implement behavior request and response validation.
Support state transitions and semantic events.
Map behavior errors to gateway responses.

tasks.title: Implement behavior runtime isolation
tasks.details: Run scenario behavior under the declared trust model with explicit isolation levels, process separation, and safe defaults.
steps: Define execution profiles for behavior code.
Restrict network and filesystem access according to profile.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic fault injection
tasks.details: Support deterministic scenario fault schedules for responses, transport failures, delays, and behavior errors.

tasks.title: Implement normalized trace capture
tasks.details: Capture one normalized trace exchange for each request, including accepted, rejected, unmatched, documentation, and semantic events.
steps: Record request, response, timing, and redaction data.
Capture semantic events from behavior backends.

tasks.title: Implement redaction and raw capture policy
tasks.details: Implement credential classes, delivery, redaction canaries, redaction representation, and optional raw capture controls.
steps: Apply deterministic redaction to traces and artifacts.
Gate raw capture by explicit configuration.

tasks.title: Implement artifact store layout
tasks.details: Write batch, trial, and study artifacts with immutable paths, manifests, frozen input hashes, implementation metadata, and evidence integrity checks.
steps: Write batch and trial directory layouts.
Write artifact manifests and frozen metadata.
Refuse overwrites of existing evidence paths.

tasks.title: Build the runner preflight
tasks.details: Validate contract, pack, eval, adapter, prompt, workflow, rubric, limits, and run profile before an agent process starts.
steps: Return setup and configuration failures before launch.

tasks.title: Implement trial setup and lifecycle
tasks.details: Create isolated trial workspaces, per-run mock servers, credentials, state, lifecycle stages, timeout handling, and terminal finalization.

tasks.title: Implement participant material and prompts
tasks.details: Generate participant workspaces, prompt roles, template variables, prompt sets, documentation visibility, and structured final-output instructions.

tasks.title: Implement agent adapter API

steps: Capture process output and exit status.

steps: Map run context to environment variables and arguments.

steps: Map run profile fields to Codex CLI flags.
Add conformance tests without paid model calls.

tasks.title: Implement oal run for trials and cohorts
tasks.details: Run one trial or a homogeneous cohort with pinned run inputs, parallelism limits, durable evidence, and visible non-success outcomes.
steps: Retain failed, timed-out, malformed, zero-request, and interrupted trials.

tasks.title: Implement raw HTTP exposure
tasks.details: Expose a trial mock over raw HTTP with independent contract visibility modes and documentation-plane handling.
steps: Serve the selected contract endpoint set.
Generate participant-visible base URLs and credentials.

tasks.title: Implement direct tool exposure

Map tool calls to gateway invocations.
Record tool exchanges in normalized trace.

tasks.title: Implement catalog tool exposure
tasks.details: Implement catalog search, describe, and invoke tools for large contracts using the shared invocation envelope.

tasks.details: Validate hidden and participant-visible Arazzo workflows, align them with traces, and support control execution.
steps: Align workflow steps with trace events.

tasks.title: Implement evaluator and rubric DSL
tasks.details: Grade trials from normalized trace, final state, artifacts, and structured final output using deterministic rubric checks.
steps: Implement check kinds, scoring, and sequence semantics.

tasks.title: Implement eval authoring commands
tasks.details: Add oal eval init, oal eval validate, and oal evaluate for task authors and offline evaluation.
steps: Validate task, prompt, scenario, result schema, and rubric links.

tasks.title: Implement reports and comparisons
tasks.details: Generate canonical JSON, terminal, and Markdown reports plus descriptive comparisons that preserve all trial outcomes and compatibility warnings.
steps: Emit required denominators and independent outcome axes.
Implement compare output with compatibility drift.

tasks.title: Implement replay and doctor commands
tasks.details: Add oal replay for evidence replay and oal doctor for environment, dependency, version, and system checks.
steps: Replay recorded traces against configured backends.

tasks.title: Implement resource limits and failure taxonomy
tasks.details: Enforce parsing, runtime, process, network, filesystem, and denial-of-service controls with normalized failure categories and retry policy.

tasks.title: Implement observability and evidence integrity

Add adversarial and real-world shape fixtures.

tasks.title: Add compiler and gateway test suites

tasks.title: Add runner and evaluator test suites

steps: Add runner integration tests without paid model calls.

Map routes, state, prompts, tasks, and rubric to pack files.

tasks.title: Add continuous integration and release gates
tasks.details: Implement pull-request, nightly, release, coverage, compatibility, and performance gates described by the specification.

Document run, report, compare, replay, and doctor workflows.

tasks.title: Complete MVP acceptance criteria
tasks.details: Verify all automated acceptance criteria for compiler, gateway, state, trace, runner, redaction, evaluator, tools, Steel migration, release completeness, workflows, and study features.
steps: Map acceptance criteria to automated tests.

tasks.title: Align capability claims and the acceptance gate
tasks.details: Correct README, usage, research-methods, and capability-matrix claims to match demonstrated behavior; separate corrected from missing requirements in tests/acceptance.map.json and acceptance.test.ts; generate coverage counts from the map; keep release readiness failing while required behavior is missing; record acceptance dependencies for T055-T060.
steps: Audit each documented workflow against the CLI and tests.
Rewrite claims: working raw HTTP execution, implemented components, rejected workflows.
Correct the webclip repair claim to its recorded evidence.
Rework the acceptance map with covered, corrected, partial, and missing statuses.

tasks.title: Bound every execution path that evaluates untrusted patterns
tasks.details: Move schema and pattern evaluation for contract- and pack-supplied regular expressions behind a shared asynchronous worker boundary with deadline, queue, message-size, and worker-resource limits; cache compiled schemas in the worker; apply to request validation, response validation and generation, participant reports, rubric checks, cue and redaction rules, and patternProperties; timeouts become infrastructure outcomes without state mutation.
steps: Add a worker-pool schema evaluator in packages/core with config limits from packages/config.
Route validator, gateway validate/response-body/pattern/generate, and exposure call sites through it.
Inventory remaining pack-supplied patterns and bound them.
Add strict-mode hostile-pattern acceptance checks and diagnostics.
Preserve existing schema and deterministic response tests.

tasks.title: Enforce supported analysis and one outcome per slot
tasks.details: Add a shared analysis support check in packages/study used by validation, planning, preflight, and analyzeStudyRun; reject risk_ratio, generic difference, and Wald options with stable diagnostics; enforce or reject every accepted analysis field; compute main and sensitivity outcomes from one slot resolution using report aggregate replacement-chain facts; run fixture-based analyze acceptance with frozen files and hashes.
steps: Implement the support check and reject unsupported options.
Audit weighting, population, eligibility, floor/ceiling, and comparison-family fields.
Unify slot resolution between packages/report and packages/study.
Fix the sensitivity expectation to the specified slot table.
Add frozen-fixture analyze tests including derived results.

tasks.title: Make webclip grading match its task
tasks.details: Map each task requirement to a required rubric check: two clip identifiers, URLs and formats, both renders, both content reads, markdown extraction, scoped deletion, quota read, and report agreement; add a bounded normalized header view; remove word-matching from the completion score; allow empty uncertainty; treat create-call count as request evidence; version the corrected pack and rubric.
steps: Rewrite the webclip task and rubric to the corrected requirements.
Add a normalized header predicate to evaluation.
Keep report schema honest and interpret values in the rubric.
Add negative controls for each removed step and review probes.
Version the pack and record regrading as derived.

steps: Unify gateway request handling behind validation.
Add scenario child bootstrap with content-hash identity.
Wire state store commit and final snapshot into the runner.
Implement the eight webclip operations in the pack behavior.
Add live scripted-participant acceptance and remove refusal guards.

Extend the generic scripted adapter control, then Codex configuration.

tasks.title: Connect scheduled assignments to durable trial execution
tasks.details: Add a public runner execution interface that accepts and validates scheduler bindings; separate opening a child batch, executing one assignment, and finalizing it; connect executeStudyRun through TrialExecutor with frozen inputs and phase locks persisted before launch; awaited assignment-ledger appends around each terminal outcome; respect paid-call ceiling, cancellation, held replacements, and slot mapping.
steps: Define the runner execution interface for scheduler bindings.
Split child-batch open, execute, and finalize lifecycle.
Persist frozen inputs, phase lock, and the assignment ledger before launch.
